//: The seed is a standalone Node program, not part of the Next build.
Node's ESM resolver requires explicit file extensions, so the seed modules
import each other as './lib.ts'. The app's tsconfig forbids that because a
bundler resolves extensionless specifiers and writing them out would be
wrong there. Two different runtimes, two different rules — so the seed gets
its own config rather than loosening the app's.
Checked by `npm run typecheck`, which runs tsc over both projects.
